confirmedFindings.title: Non-Constant Time Password Comparison
confirmedFindings.body: Comparing digest authentication hashes using === string equality introduces a timing side-channel that allows attackers to iteratively deduce digest characters via response latency measurement.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Use crypto.timingSafeEqual with equal length buffer checks.
